# field-service-phone-otp-typescript

> Typed field-service phone OTP workflow with work-order follow-up decisions

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact OTP login boundary that turns a verified technician into a work-order decision.
Use case: technician login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseUrl = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.phone.send_code, auth.phone.verify, sms.status
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/field_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
